_about: Son Ocaq (STORY_BIBLE §3.9): a village grown around an old caravanserai; the last hearth burns in its courtyard. Rooms open onto the courtyard, behind an arched gallery on the north, west and east sides (side n/w/e/s, slot 0..); the south side has the entrance portal (eyvan) in the middle and no gallery. Each room has one door (stable id) and the residents who sleep there (NPC ids; 'protagonist' is Aras). room_rules move an NPC to another room while a condition holds (first match wins). outside: daytime workplaces just outside the gate ('workers' stand there by day; nobody sleeps there). services: hub services unlocked when their NPC lives here (placeholder hooks). hearth.stages: flame scale per number of resolved core grief arcs (NPCs tagged core_grief). Positions are computed by scripts/hub/hub_level.gd.

rooms._about: Kemal and Gülçin sleep here; the birth happens here (STORY_BIBLE Act III).

room_rules._about: Sona may move into Aras's room later [TBD trigger]

night_shades._about: Placeholder Küllüler roaming the courtyard at night: they walk from door to door and knock, never attack; within break_range of Aras a shade breaks into ash and re-forms elsewhere after reform_seconds. Narin's small shade at Aras's door never breaks; it is simply gone by morning.

life._about: What makes Son Ocaq feel lived in (scripts/hub/hub_life.gd, a view: it holds no state). ambience: looping sound by phase, faded in and out. hearth_sound: the fire, positional. smoke: place ids whose chimney smokes while someone is home there (the spot is taken from the place's own door transform, so it follows the layout). laundry: a rope between two points with cloth hanging from it, swaying. market: the stalls and who stands where by day. routine: where an NPC is in each phase — door (their own door), work (workplace, else their market spot, else their door), hearth (a ring round the fire), inside (behind a closed door).

smoke._about: back/height: how far behind the facade and how high above it the chimney sits. scale: the plume's size (a chimney, not a bonfire).

birds._about: Few: the courtyard sees little sky and every flock is a draw call.
